headline: The Kandinsky developers released two free video models that make short clips with matching speech, music and sound.
score_reason: Kept at 5: a capable open release but with five-second clips and developer-only benchmark claims.
importance_line: Hobbyists, small studios and developers get a free video-and-sound generator they can run themselves, but clips are limited to five seconds and the quality claims come from the developers' own comparisons.
summary: Gearbrain reports, relaying the developers' announcement, that Kandinsky 6.0 Video comes as a 29-billion-parameter Pro model and a 3-billion-parameter Lite model that make clips of up to five seconds with lip-synced speech, music and ambient sound, with code and weights under the MIT licence, which allows free use including in products. The developers say Lite runs on consumer Nvidia graphics cards and that Pro beats the open LTX 2.5 and trails only MiniMax H3 among open models, but those comparisons are their own.
